title: Barista quality espresso at home
text: The brew temperature is perfectly consistent and milk frothing wand produces silky microfoam. Easy to clean with intuitive front panel controls.

title: Leaking water reservoir after 2 months
text: Started leaking water all over my kitchen counter. The plastic tank seal is defective. Customer support said replacement parts are on backorder for 6 weeks.

title: Great morning coffee maker for busy folks
text: Heats up in 30 seconds and brews a piping hot cup of coffee with thick rich crema. Compact footprint fits nicely in my small apartment kitchen.

title: Loud grinding noise and difficult to clean
text: The built-in grinder sounds like a jet engine at 6 AM. Cleaning the internal grinder chute is a nightmare and coffee grounds get stuck everywhere.

title: Solid machine, worth every penny
text: Stainless steel body feels durable and elegant. Programming custom shot volumes is straightforward. Best coffee machine I have ever owned.

title: Mediocre temperature, coffee is lukewarm
text: Even on the highest temperature setting, the coffee comes out barely warm. Have to microwave my cup after brewing. Very disappointing for $400.

title: Exceptional customer service made things right
text: Had an issue with the steam wand pressure. Reached out to customer support and they shipped a replacement unit with prepaid return label within 48 hours. Five stars!

title: Flimsy plastic buttons broke off
text: Within four months, the power button snapped off. Cheap build materials disguised beneath stainless steel veneer. Buyer beware.
